construct_CallGraph_from_Trace: construct a CallGraph from a parsed Trace object to analyze call stacks across ranks
get_stack_of_node: get the call stack of a specific node with an option to skip or include ancestor nodes
get_call_stacks: iterate over all call stacks with optional filtering by rank, pid, tid, or stack index
get_csg_of_node: get the CallStackGraph that contains a given node index to inspect parent-child relationships
build_CallGraph_from_dataframe: build a CallGraph directly from a pandas DataFrame and symbol table without a full Trace
